title: Story premise ENT012: The Quietest Drum Solo
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (two-person rivalry). Hook: My drum solo is quieter than yours. Takeaway/theme: A limitation can reveal a new audience.
description: Two neighbors compete to practice music more quietly, progressing from padded drums to finger taps to invisible performances. Their silent showdown accidentally attracts a crowd of readers, and they turn the rivalry into a silent concert with caption cards and choreographed bows.
